title: Retail Installment Contracts Fee Schedule: Returned Payments, Certified-Funds Threshold and Courtesy Waivers
content:
## Returned payments

| Tier | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Returned-payment fees per contract per calendar month, at most | Fee-bearing returns that place the contract on certified-funds-only status | Rolling window for that count |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 25.00 | 2 | 2 | 12 months |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 25.00 | 2 | 2 | 12 months |
| Tier 4 Standard | 25.00 | 2 | 2 | 12 months |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 25.00 | 2 | 3 | 12 months |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 25.00 | 2 | 3 | 12 months |
| Tier 1 Select | 25.00 | 2 | 3 | 12 months |

**Fee-bearing return reasons** (every tier of Retail Installment Contracts): insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment and uncollected funds. A payment the borrower's bank returns unpaid for one of these reasons is a fee-bearing return; a return for any other reason is not.

## Courtesy waivers

| Tier | Courtesy waivers a representative may grant per rolling 12 months | Largest single fee a courtesy waiver may cover (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 0 | 25.00 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 1 | 25.00 |
| Tier 4 Standard | 1 | 25.00 |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 1 | 25.00 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 2 | 25.00 |
| Tier 1 Select | 2 | 25.00 |

A courtesy waiver covers a late charge or a returned-payment fee.

**Rolling windows.** "Rolling 12 months" counts records dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the day in question (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) and on or before that day.

**Hypothetical comparisons.** Two fee-bearing returns within the rolling 12 months reach the certified-funds count of a Tier 5 Rebuild contract but not that of a Tier 3 Advantage contract, which needs 3. A Tier 6 Fresh Start contract has a courtesy-waiver allowance of 0, so no courtesy waiver is available on it in any 12 months.
